title: baxter
caption: Turns incoming requests into scoped tasks, schedules the work and checks completion.
workflow: Triage the request, define a task and reserve the files it needs. Work with conflicting edits waits its turn. A separate verification step checks the result before Baxter marks it done.
benefit: A worker saying finished is not the same as proof.
demo: Schedule overlapping tasks, change capacity and see failed evidence held for repair.
source: Public baxter_usage.py, baxter_lanes.py, baxter_verify.py and PRD workflow.
boundary: A deterministic scheduler and verification example. It does not contact inboxes or launch paid agents.
